description.value: Rio Brazilian Steakhouse is a family-owned churrascaria chain with three BC locations, serving all-you-can-eat rodizio-style barbecue where servers carve meats tableside from skewers in the tradition of southern Brazilian Gauchos. The Coquitlam location on Barnet Highway has been operating since 2017 and hosts live Samba shows on Fridays. A separate takeout and delivery menu is also available for those not dining in.

raw_osm.name: Rio Brazilian Steak House
raw_osm.note: All you can eat for one price menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Rio Brazilian Steakhouse is an active, multi-location churrascaria with a full takeout/delivery menu and explicit gluten-free claims; a blog post dated November 2025 confirms the Coquitlam location is still operating. OSM lists no phone number but the website clearly shows (604) 941-9969 for the Coquitlam location; a postcode discrepancy exists between the website's front page (V6C3R3) and OSM/website footer (V3E 1K9), which appears to be a website typo since V3E 1K9 appears in the more detailed address sections. None of the required WWC cycling criteria — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere in the website content, leaving all three null.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'Rio Brazilian Steak House' (two words) while the website consistently uses 'Rio Brazilian Steakhouse' (one word).
Postcode discrepancy: the website front page lists the Coquitlam postcode as V6C3R3, while OSM and the website footer/about page use V3E 1K9; V6C3R3 appears to be a website error.
Phone number is absent from OSM; (604) 941-9969 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, active restaurant that could serve touring cyclists on the Barnet Highway corridor, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking or visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is needed before inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly states 'It's a Gluten-Free Paradise'; takeout menu lists multiple vegetarian-friendly salad options (Kale, Carrot, Chickpea, Spicy Tofu, Yam). No explicit vegan claim made
